parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: The personal access token. This parameter is not required if you use an AccessKey pair or STS token for authentication.

parameters.name: localId
parameters.description: The local ID of the merge request. The ID is unique in a repository.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The organization ID. You can find the ID in the URL when you log on to the Apsara DevOps console. The URL is in the format of `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`.

parameters.name: repositoryIdentity
parameters.description: The ID or full path of the repository.
